SELECT CASE federal_agency_prefix WHEN '93' THEN 'Health and Human Services' WHEN '10' THEN 'Agriculture' WHEN '84' THEN 'Education' WHEN '14' THEN 'Housing and Urban Development' WHEN '20' THEN 'Transportation' WHEN '97' THEN 'Homeland Security' WHEN '21' THEN 'Treasury' WHEN '17' THEN 'Labor' WHEN '16' THEN 'Justice' WHEN '81' THEN 'Energy' WHEN '66' THEN 'Environmental Protection Agency' WHEN '12' THEN 'Defense' WHEN '47' THEN 'National Science Foundation' WHEN '64' THEN 'Veterans Affairs' WHEN '15' THEN 'Interior' WHEN '11' THEN 'Commerce' WHEN '43' THEN 'NASA' ELSE federal_agency_prefix END AS department, sum(try_cast(amount_expended AS double)) AS expended FROM govblock_executive.fac_federal_awards WHERE audit_year = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the combined capacity of all wind turbines in Kansas, in megawatts?
SELECT sum(try_cast(t_cap AS double)) / 1000 AS megawatts FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'KS'
Which databases supplied the most ChEBI entries?
SELECT source, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_compounds WHERE source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of the Southwest Power Pool's electricity came from wind in 2023?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double))) / sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw AS double)), 1) AS wind_pct FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'SWPP' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which stocks show up most often in funds' quarterly holdings reports?
SELECT nameofissuer, count(*) AS holdings FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the Highway Trust Fund's balance on September 30, 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS balance FROM govblock_treasury.highway_trust_fund_results WHERE account_desc LIKE 'Balance Sept%30, 2024'
What kinds of generator have been retired most often?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled

SELECT technology, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS retired FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'RE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent families does SureChEMBL cover?
SELECT count(DISTINCT family_id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents
Which Texas cities are home to the most named inventors?
SELECT inventor_city_name, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 WHERE inventor_region_code = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in the clinical toxicity set failed trials for toxicity?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_clintox WHERE ct_tox = 1
Which hospitals treated the most Medicare patients for sepsis in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_org_name AS hospital, rndrng_prvdr_state_abrvtn AS state, sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double)) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' AND drg_desc LIKE 'SEPTICEMIA%' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many 10-K annual reports were filed with the SEC in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE form = '10-K' AND substr(cast(filed AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2023'
Which compounds are named in the most patents?

SELECT t.c1 AS compound, count(DISTINCT p.c1) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_patent AS p JOIN govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title AS t ON t.c0 = p.c0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Was unemployment higher in Ohio or in Michigan at the end of 2024?
SELECT series_id, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id IN ('LASST390000000000003', 'LASST260000000000003') AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which law reporters carry the most cases in the archive?
SELECT reporter, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.citations WHERE reporter IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the total public debt outstanding on September 30, 2024?
SELECT try_cast(tot_pub_debt_out_amt AS double) AS total_debt FROM govblock_treasury.debt_to_penny WHERE record_date = '2024-09-30'
Which states are home to the most companies filing financial statements with the SEC?
SELECT stprba, count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE countryba = 'US' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the Democratic presidential vote in Westchester County change from 2016 to 2024?

SELECT year, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'NEW YORK' AND county_name = 'WESTCHESTER' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND party_simplified = 'DEMOCRAT' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which countries host the most clinical trials?
SELECT country, count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_locations WHERE country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of adults in Los Angeles County have diabetes?

SELECT try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'DIABETES' AND datavaluetypeid = 'CrdPrv' AND locationname = 'Los Angeles' AND stateabbr = 'CA' AND year = '2022'
How many robocall complaints did people in Florida file with the FCC in 2021?
SELECT count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE state = 'FL' AND issue LIKE '%Robocall%' AND date_created LIKE '%/2021'
How did New York City's unemployment rate change from April 2020 to December 2024?

SELECT year, period, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUCT365100000000003' AND ((cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period = 'M04') OR (cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12')) ORDER BY year
Which molecular formulas are shared by the most PubChem compounds?
SELECT c1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a gallon of whole milk cost on average in December 2024?
SELECT value AS dollars_per_gallon FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU0000709112' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
How many independents serve in state legislatures across the country?
SELECT count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE party = 'I'
Which cities are home to the most federal political committees?
SELECT cmte_city, cmte_st, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemistry patents were published by the World Intellectual Property Organization in 2015?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE country = 'WO' AND substr(cast(publication_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2015'
Which companies operate the most natural gas pipeline segments?
SELECT replace(operator, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_natural_gas_pipelines WHERE replace(operator, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much electricity came from hydroelectric dams in 2023?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.HYC-US-99.A' AND period = '2023'
Which journals charge authors the highest publication fees?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(apc_usd AS double) AS fee_usd FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_sources ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Were most people killed in 2022 road crashes men or women?

SELECT sexname, count(*) AS killed, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What kinds of informal enforcement do regulators use most against water polluters?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many businesses registered in SAM.gov list a physical address in Montana?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_province_or_state = 'MT'
Which vendors were paid the most by federal campaigns in 2024?
SELECT name, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS paid FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(rpt_yr AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much child support did the offset program collect from tax refunds in 2024?

SELECT sum(try_cast(net_offset_amt AS double)) AS collected FROM govblock_treasury.treasury_offset_program WHERE mixed_stream LIKE 'Tax Refund - Child Sup%' AND substr(cast(record_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024'
How are applications most often linked to an earlier one: continuation, provisional, division?

SELECT CASE continuation_type WHEN 'CON' THEN 'continuation' WHEN 'PRO' THEN 'claims a provisional' WHEN 'NST' THEN 'national stage' WHEN 'CIP' THEN 'continuation in part' WHEN 'DIV' THEN 'division' WHEN 'REI' THEN 'reissue' ELSE continuation_type END AS link, count(*) AS links FROM govblock_patents.patex_continuity_parents_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did independent expenditures supporting candidates change from the 1996 cycle to 2006?

SELECT cast(cycle AS varchar) AS cycle, sum(transaction_amt) AS dollars FROM govblock_fec.committee_transactions WHERE transaction_tp = '24E' AND cast(cycle AS varchar) IN ('1996', '2006') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which managers reported the largest stock portfolios for the last quarter of 2024?

SELECT c.filingmanager_name, max(try_cast(s.tablevaluetotal AS double)) AS reported_value FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_summarypage s JOIN govblock_sec.sec_13f_coverpage c ON c.accession_number = s.accession_number JOIN govblock_sec.sec_13f_submission b ON b.accession_number = s.accession_number WHERE b.periodofreport = '31-DEC-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
